maddeler.e:
تستمطروا (form X)
# تَسْتَمْطِرُوا (tastamṭirū) /tas.tam.tˤi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَمْطَرَ (istamṭara)
# تُسْتَمْطَرُوا (tustamṭarū) /tus.tam.tˤa.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَمْطَرَ (istamṭara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
